selectionRule: A map or target is selected because it makes the operation's decision legible. Map variety alone is not a reason to create or retain a quest. Every selection remains fail-closed until exact SPT 4.1.5 target names/roles and current semantic overlap are proven.

acoustic-discipline.purpose: Open terrain and long approaches make listening and route verification plausible without requiring combat.
acoustic-discipline.continuity: Establishes the same wider field route later used by Acoustic Contact.

forward-reserve.purpose: This is a logistics handover between raids; inventing a raid location would add friction without adding a decision.

low-profile.purpose: A commercial complex full of improvised equipment and opportunistic traffic supports the idea of moving with ordinary, replaceable gear rather than a premium display loadout.

mobility-doctrine.purpose: Long movement between exposed and built-up terrain makes mobility a real reason to prefer lighter protection rather than merely the next armor tier.

borrowed-access.purpose: A restricted interior route is used as access reconnaissance; the objective is entry and confirmation, not key ownership.

acoustic-contact.purpose: Returns to the route established by Acoustic Discipline, but now the problem is a real hostile presence rather than uncertain sound.

route-security.purpose: Customs functions as the campaign's practical logistics corridor; this is the consequence operation after access and supply work, not a generic map-clear quest.

contractor-intercept.purpose: A military movement node supports a short counter-contractor intercept distinct from ordinary route clearance.
contractor-intercept.targetIntent: AnyPmc unless a narrower exact SPT 4.1.5 faction selector is proven and materially improves the operation

timeWindowCandidate.intent: Give the hostile movement window a real gameplay meaning instead of leaving it as flavor text.
timeWindowCandidate.preferredShape: native Kills daytime window inside the same CounterCreator if exact SPT 4.1.5 semantics support it
timeWindowCandidate.rejectIf: The time restriction produces scheduling annoyance, materially duplicates a current vanilla objective, or cannot be proven against exact SPT 4.1.5.

observation-window.purpose: Long natural sightlines make stand-off control intelligible without turning the operation into an arbitrary distance staircase.
observation-window.targetIntent: One or two specific practical threats; prefer a role/context that is not simply AnyPmc at range.
observation-window.distanceIntent: One meaningful minimum band selected after exact SPT 4.1.5 distance semantics and current vanilla precision overlap are measured.

heavy-assault.purpose: Short sightlines and compressed contact make accepting heavy protection a coherent tactical choice, sharply separating this operation from Shoreline Mobility Doctrine.
heavy-assault.targetIntent: ordinary hostile element unless a more specific target survives overlap review

break-the-perimeter.purpose: Rogue defensive positions give the perimeter-disruption theme an actual prepared threat rather than another ordinary road clearance.
break-the-perimeter.waterTreatmentBoundary: Water Treatment is narrative context until an exact SPT 4.1.5 sub-location condition is proven. Do not imply a zone selector that runtime cannot enforce.

internal-security.purpose: Existing Labs access is exercised under pressure; the operation tests using clearance, controlling one Raider response and leaving, not earning another access token.

continuityPairs.reason: Reconnaissance first, combat application later. Reusing the map is intentional narrative continuity rather than copied objective structure.
Restricted access is confirmed first; broader logistics movement is defended later.
An early movement lesson later becomes stand-off control; the required equipment and target behavior are different.

deliberateContrast.contrast: Shoreline rewards movement under light protection; Factory justifies accepting heavy protection for a compressed assault.
Customs ordinary Scav corridor pressure -> Reserve trained contractor movement window -> Lighthouse prepared Rogue perimeter.
